Hey S-JohnA!!!! You are a wonderful person,   time is on your side,
with minutes to hours to days n months and of course years of meaningful great experiences still to come your way.

Life Is a wild wild world of possibilities.  YOU aint alone. 
     They say time heals all wounds. well Maybe, but more importantly we can self heal in very important ways.  

Give yourself a break, and a forgiveness for what seems now a bad response to your older brother.   

What I found with the passage of time, was insight into me, my family, my friends, my enemies, too.

An old timer from down the block tracked me down when i was 19, he came a walking slowly with his cane.   
<> he said, "you just one of the many billions here right now on earth, and your stirring yourself up terribly about not being perfect,  and that is an illusion. everyone could have done better on a whole lot of things.  effort to play that differently in your mind, 
    forgive yourself twice as fast today as you did yesterday, and everyday going forward.  
         then forgive all of' 'thems' for what they did not get right, all of them, .....and all of yours too, 
         because then you have paid for ticket to live in the NOW!!!  for which your lungs are breathing for you to do, 
    but you see our heads will get so stuck in the past, till NOW seems like no-way,  but then we will block ourselves to be that older brother/friend to a family members or to a neighbor member, or to persons off the street, where we breathe in NOW, and think and share thoughts of thanks in the NOW, and connecting."

He patted me on the shoulder, turned and slow stepped away with his cane down the block.   

Never saw him again.  About 3 weeks later he passed, none of us in the neighborhood knew that until 6 months later.  

That got me thinking about what he said after i heard he had died, and even 46 years later now too, i keep thinking of how to apply his advice.  

What worked was peace in the mind, just enough that i could forgive myself, sometimes quicker than otherwise, and all the "Thems" that were rude to down right committed atrocities to me and those i Love.

Thats what i had to compete with across the years with the biggest heaps, anger and its bad friends in my head.  Allowing them anger&friends to walkout of my mind has been an artful dance for decades.

For me, years later, i put down to what i could not earlier on,  but was still stroking it anyway.  that is
Seeking words in my head that would be encouragements to others.

And when I sensed a chance, to share some of those words with others, 
   and when it was clear i could share a small action or two that would be helpful to a person that had it worse off than me.  
         that went on for years, until this phrase finally hit me to describe it, 
         "In the service of others we discover who we really are."    
    And sense we truly are always in a process of becoming ourselves, 
those kindred thoughts, kindred shared words, small acts of kindness, can guide us through the mazes of life's trilogies.

Brothers can move there minds and hearts away from us,
its just an "IS" of life, like the sun and the moon and the earth

 because the tides of life pulled our brother away, and they became bitter, and lost levels of their own self respect, 
so thats what my 3 brothers over sequences of years  did too -----====---- began only to understand that until years later, too
.
Of course for a time, like a damn decade, i blamed it solely on myself.  
Until the words from my Old neighbor friend,  finally arrived at that part in my mind too.  

Forgiveness can be like a lung, and we gotta breathe it into everyday, sometimes on stuff that just recently happened, 
and other times on old redressed memorys of painful events, 
but it is never too late, to breathe in and out of our forgiveness lungs.


So you see S-JohnA, you are exactly where you ought to be, neither behind or ahead, that phrase from a movie with Matt Damon comes to mind "You are a Good Egg Man!"
